verdict.rationale: Rippling's global payroll pages say it pays employees and contractors worldwide in one system. They also say it calculates and files payroll taxes for employees worldwide and manages global HR, payroll and compliance together, and a customer quote describes running three countries in one system. That covers the story's 'or owned-entity global payroll' path, so EOR is not required for a full verdict. Missing for 10: any explicit employer-of-record offering, explicit mention of running payroll through your own foreign entities, a list of supported countries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of international employment.
